# Atlantic City: The Human Condition - Security Camera locations

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Mar 26, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Mar 29, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d1e5b502804e46f3818ada5546429e3d~mv2.png)

With thanks to Coffee888.

****SUBJECT TO CHANGE PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS****

There are 5 possible spawn locations for the Security Camera Footage, with only 1 spawning per expedition.

A map marker will appear on your HUD when you are 20 feet away from the Security Camera.

Both the Team Leader and Teammates can collect them.

Photo of a Security Camera.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_14e138903ae343e691a2bc17899c4ebb~mv2.jpg)

__Map of Community Center__

Downloadable copy __here__. 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_272c67ece4454eb08b5e62d9b9da346f~mv2.png)

**Location #1**

From the lobby, go up the stairs in front of you. Turn right and follow the stairs to the top. Veer slightly left and keep walking North, past the wagon in the middle.

Stop at the hole in the floor and turn right. Walk straight, past the door on your left and turn left into the hole in the wall just past the door.

The Security Camera is on the Eastern wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_30a2192d0fca4934a74753c79ca90fa3~mv2.jpg)

**Location # 2**

Library

Enter the library and look for the room with the tree growing in the middle. The Security Camera will be on the West wall in the corner.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_da1182d4da244877bfdb95b051170a77~mv2.jpg)

**Location # 3**

Swimming Pool.

Enter the Swimming Pool section via the bathroom off the lobby. The Security Camera is on the Eastern Wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d123c811d0444d11bfe9c0c16b9c9c72~mv2.jpg)

**Location # 4**

Gym

Enter the gym and face South. Look up and you will see a broken wall between some red curtains. Jump or jetpack up to the hole in the wall. You can stand on the table or the basketball ring to give you a jump boost. The Security Camera is on the Eastern wall of the VIP room.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5a6b62e96dab43cf94e5b2848225b9f5~mv2.jpg)

**Location # 5**

Theater

From the front door, head North. Ignore the stairs and walk around them instead.

Walk under the "theater" sign and go up the stairs in front of you.

Turn left and follow the path around. Jump off the balcony at the end.

On the ground, turn around and the Security Camera will be on the South wall, in the middle.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_920633c128934646aa24a7657458b1d9~mv2.jpg)
